name: Playwright
purpose: End-to-end tests that gate every release.

tasks.title: Add Playwright to the build
steps: Configure Chromium, WebKit, and a desktop viewport first, then mobile

tasks.title: Run tests in CI on every pull request
steps: Add a GitHub Actions job (NN-GITHUB-04) and make it a required check
Upload the HTML report and traces on failure

tasks.title: Cover the critical paths
steps: Create, edit, and delete a core record
The main dashboard loads with data
AI features return a response or a graceful fallback
tasks.doneWhen: Each critical path has at least one test.

tasks.title: Use generic test data only
steps: Seed with obviously fictional demo personas and sample amounts
Never use real names, accounts, or transactions in fixtures
tasks.doneWhen: Fixtures reviewed and contain no personal data.

tasks.title: Smoke-test production after deploy
steps: Run the @smoke-tagged tests against the live URL after the Cloudflare purge (NN-CLOUDFLARE-06)
tasks.doneWhen: Smoke suite is green on production.

tasks.title: Weekly flaky-test review
steps: Find tests that needed retries and fix the root cause; never skip them to go green
tasks.doneWhen: No test depends on retries to pass.
